title: Giving up on tributes and TV shows
summary: Roy says he is done with ceremonies after various mix-ups.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I did not. I spoke to Max, though. I saw Max the day after, and he said it turned out nice.

I had to give up on all that. After I had that fiasco with taking the picture and not being on Coleman's thing, and they told me that Kai Winding's thing was something and then it turned out to be something

different altogether... I don't need that, you know. It's too late for that now, you know. I don't know what the hell the story was, but I've just given up on it. I'd have given up on this TV show, too, if I'd found out that they had anything to do with it. That would destroy me!
Well, his brother, he's in the advertising business. He does the commercials for the Daily News, you know.
